effectsSummary: DOB 是一种强效且持续时间长的迷幻剂。产生视幻觉、时间感知改变、自我消解。起效可能需要 2-3 小时。
generalRisks: 血压危险升高。惊恐发作和心理困扰风险。过热风险。持续时间极长（可达 24 小时以上）。
longtermRisks: 尚无长期风险研究结果。可能发生 HPPD。主要风险是体验过程中的心理困扰。
saferUse: 只使用毫克秤精確測量劑量。
安排清醒的陪護人在場。
確保有充足的時間（至少 24 小時）。
避免與其他藥物混合使用。
從低劑量開始，逐步增加。
[TBT] Mixed use of these potent substances should be avoided at all costs.

[TBT] As amphetamine derivatives, DOB can be particularly draining because of their long duration of action. Light vitamin-rich food, fruits, vegetable juices, vitamins and minerals promote a soft landing after the trip has subsided and can weaken a hangover.
[TBT] Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
[TBT] A trip with DOB should remain an exceptional experience. Make sure to take long breaks from consumption so that the experience can be processed.
